# Machines & Cloud

> Machines & Cloud builds AI front desk agents for service businesses: a website chat agent and phone receptionist that answers customers, captures leads, and books appointments 24/7, with human handoff for anything risky. Houston based, founder led. Front Desk Agent from $1,497 to build plus $397 per month, live in 7 days.
